hints.title: Substring Chunking
hints.text: Divide string s into contiguous substrings of length k.

hints.title: Modular Hash Mapping
hints.text: Sum character positions (0 for a, 1 for b, etc.) within each chunk and compute total modulo twenty-six.

hints.title: Character Conversion
hints.text: Map modulo twenty-six value back to its alphabetical character and append to the output string.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct chunking is already optimal; extra string allocations are negligible.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Straightforward string segmentation and ASCII modulo arithmetic.
